an8.52:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an8.52:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.52:1.3: ‘katīhi nu kho bhante dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu
an8.52:2.1: bhikkhuno' vādako sammannitabbo' ti? Aṭṭhahi kho Ānanda dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhikkhuno' vādako sammannibabbo.
an8.52:2.3: Idh' Ānanda bhikkhu sīlavā hoti . . . pe . . . samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu,
an8.52:2.5: ubhayāni kho pan' assa pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anuvyañjanaso,
an8.52:2.6: kalyāṇavāco hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriya vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā,
an8.52:2.7: paṭibalo hoti bhikkhunīsaṅghaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetuṃ samādapetuṃ samuttejetuṃ sampahaṃsetuṃ,
an8.52:2.9: na kho pan' etaṃ Bhagavantaṃ uddissa pabbajitāya kāsāyavatthanivasanāya garudhammaṃ ajjhāpannapubbo hoti,
an8.52:2.11: Imehi kho Ānanda aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhikkhuno' vādako sammannitabbo
